content: If someone experiences severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, it is critical to call 911 immediately. For other cases, contact a poison control center without delay. In the United States, you can reach the poison control center at 1-800-222-1222. While using this medication, it is essential to undergo regular laboratory and medical tests, such as assessments of kidney and liver function, potassium and magnesium levels, and complete blood counts. Ensure that you attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments. If you miss a dose of this medication, it is important to consult your doctor or pharmacist promptly to establish a new dosing schedule. Do not attempt to adjust the dosage on your own. For storage instructions, refer to the product guidelines or consult your pharmacist. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This medication is used to treat serious fungal infections, particularly in patients who cannot tolerate or do not respond to standard amphotericin treatments. It is typically administered via intravenous injection, as directed by your doctor, usually once daily. The infusion should be administered slowly over a period of two hours. If you are administering this medication at home, ensure that you have received thorough training from your healthcare provider on preparation and usage. Before use, visually inspect the product for particles or discoloration. If either is present, do not use the medication. Infusion reactions may occur during the administration of this drug. To mitigate these side effects, your doctor may prescribe additional medications, such as acetaminophen, diphenhydramine, or corticosteroids like hydrocortisone, prior to each treatment. Notify your doctor immediately if you experience symptoms of an infusion reaction, including fever, shaking, chills, flushing, loss of appetite, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, headache, shortness of breath, or rapid breathing. Treatment with this medication may need to continue for several weeks to months, depending on the specific infection being treated. Remember that this medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits outweigh the potential risks of side effects. Severe allergic reactions to this drug are rare. However, this is not an exhaustive list of possible side effects. If you are in the United States, contact your doctor for medical advice regarding side effects. In Canada, consult your doctor for similar guidance. Before using amphotericin/lipid complex, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other complications. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary. It is not known whether this drug passes into breast milk, so consult your doctor before breastfeeding. Drug interactions may alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs as well as herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. This medication may interfere with certain laboratory tests, such as phosphate levels, potentially leading to inaccurate test results. Inform laboratory personnel and your doctors about your use of this medication. In the event of an overdose with serious symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. In the United States, the poison control center can be reached at 1-800-222-1222. This information was last revised in May 2024. It is a summary and does not contain all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individualized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
